policy.purpose: Budget only the Icecrown tasks reachable without Cold Weather Flying after applying verified hidden prerequisites, using marginal wall-clock work after overlap.

15.basis: 黑色观察站后半多轮复生密室/Fleshwerks任务，不再接被阻断的飞艇后续

16.basis: 寻找移动的奥格瑞姆之锤并交我还没死，清空当前可达路线任务日志
